doesNotEstablish: That a caller request was answered. A sync state and a health state are what the controller reports. They are not a caller outcome.
That a field with a state other than reported had any value. A field that was not reported is not healthy, not synced, and not unhealthy.
What happened between two samples. A state that began and ended between two samples leaves no transition.
That the controller applied the commit it reports, or that an applied object was rendered at that commit.
That the reported commit is on a branch, or that a merge was reviewed.
Anything about the API image or the hand-written values. Neither is read from the reported commit.
That the record holds no secret. It is built from an allowlist of fields, and a message is cut and passed through a prefix heuristic.
